title: Unleashing the Power of Edge-Cloud Generative AI in Mobile Networks: A Survey of AIGC Services
affiliation: NTU Singapore, Sun Yat-sen University, Auburn University, University of Houston, University of Sydney, Sungkyunkwan University, University of Waterloo, UBC, Princeton University
domain: Mobile Edge Computing / Generative AI / AIGC Services / Edge Intelligence / 6G Networks
paper_type: Comprehensive Survey with Tutorial Elements and Case Studies

analysis_policy.focus: Extract mobile AIGC network architecture, generative AI model taxonomy, and deployment challenges
analysis_policy.depth: Full paper analysis including all 8 sections and 4 case studies

section_flow.title: Introduction
section_flow.summary: Introduces AIGC paradigm shift from PGC/UGC, motivates mobile AIGC networks for low-latency, localized, personalized, privacy-preserving services. Compares with existing surveys.
key_claims: AIGC reduces marginal cost of content creation to nearly zero
ChatGPT, DALL-E represent breakthrough in generative AI
Cloud-only AIGC has high latency; edge deployment needed
First survey to focus on mobile AIGC network deployment

section_flow.title: Background and Fundamentals of AIGC
section_flow.summary: Defines AIGC characteristics (automatic, creative, multimodal, diverse, valuable), details ChatGPT lifecycle (pre-training, fine-tuning, inference, product management), introduces AIGC lifecycle at edge.
key_claims: AIGC combines automation of PGC with creativity of UGC
GPT-3 has 175 billion parameters trained on massive corpus
AIGC lifecycle: data collection → pre-training → fine-tuning → inference → product management
Stable Diffusion pre-training: 256 A100 GPUs, 150K hours, ~$600K

section_flow.title: Technologies and Collaborative Infrastructure
section_flow.summary: Presents generative AI model taxonomy (GAN, VAE, Flow, Diffusion, LLM), evaluation metrics (IS, FID, R-Precision, CLIP-R-Precision, QoE), and cloud-edge-mobile collaborative architecture.
key_claims: Five fundamental generative models: GAN, energy-based, VAE, flow-based, diffusion
Diffusion models avoid mode collapse via MLE training
LLMs face challenges: long response times, high bandwidth, data privacy
Cloud-edge collaborative training + edge-mobile collaborative inference

section_flow.title: Applications and Advantages of AIGC
section_flow.summary: Categorizes AIGC applications by modality: text (ALBERT, MobileBERT), audio (WaveNet, Audio ALBERT), image (Make-a-Scene, SPADE), video (Imagen Video), 3D (NeRF, Latent-NeRF, Diffusion-SDF).
key_claims: ALBERT and MobileBERT enable edge-deployable NLG
Audio ALBERT shows 20% inference time reduction
Make-a-Scene leverages human priors for text-to-image
Deepfake concerns require study and legislation

section_flow.title: Case Studies of AIGC in Mobile Network
section_flow.summary: Presents 4 detailed case studies: diffusion-based contract design for semantic communication, DRL-based ASP selection (20 ASPs, 1000 users), vehicular Metaverse simulation, blockchain-based AIGC product lifecycle.
key_claims: AI-generated contract outperforms SAC (185.9) and PPO (184.3) with utility 189.1
DRL-based ASP selection outperforms random, round-robin, crash-avoid policies
MTEPViSA mechanism improves 150% social surplus vs baselines
Reputation-based ESP selection balances workload and incentivizes honest behavior

section_flow.title: Implementation Challenges
section_flow.summary: Identifies 6 major challenge categories with detailed KPIs, techniques, and mathematical tools. Covers model accuracy vs resource tradeoff, offloading latency, cache management, and FL privacy.
key_claims: Model accuracy, bandwidth utilization, resource consumption as key KPIs
ADMM for AI service placement and resource allocation
DNN partitioning for edge-mobile collaboration
FL, differential privacy, blockchain for privacy preservation

section_flow.title: Future Research Directions
section_flow.summary: Discusses future directions: distributed diffusion, foundation model caching, 6G wireless communication design, model compression, digital twin integration.
key_claims: Distributed diffusion across edge devices emerging
Foundation model caching and inference optimization needed
AI-generated 6G network design using diffusion models
Digital twin for Metaverse content generation

section_flow.title: Conclusion
section_flow.summary: Summarizes mobile AIGC network vision, emphasizes cloud-edge-mobile collaboration, and highlights remaining challenges.
